recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a dark left-hand sidebar for track listings and a large, rounded-corner frame on the right containing a cinematic illustration of a night drive under palm trees, encased in a glowing neon-bulb border.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy left column balanced by a central illustrative window
Warm orange/yellow car hood anchoring the bottom of the frame
Cool blue and black night sky contrasting with glowing orange neon lights
Vertical hierarchy of artist names and song titles using color-coding
coreInvariants: Rounded-rectangle frame with a double-line neon glow effect
Silhouetted palm trees against a dark sky
Three figures visible inside a car interior

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main illustration occupies the right two-thirds of the canvas, while the text list occupies the left third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange car hood at the bottom right acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left artist name, move down the list, then jump to the central title in the frame, and finally down to the car interior.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background on the left provides high contrast for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Light Blue for artist names and sky highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Yellow and Orange for song titles and neon border glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows and oranges against a low-value black and dark blue environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Cyan, Yellow, Orange, and Black

characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked 'THE' or small 'AND' to fit within line heights
Interlocking characters in song titles to save horizontal space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded alternation between two high-impact condensed fonts or weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed 70s display feel.
Provides the clean, uniform stroke weight seen in the artist names.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark night scene with a vintage car interior at the bottom. Include two palm trees silhouetted against a dark sky with a glowing white star-trail in the center. Enclose the scene in a rounded rectangle frame with a glowing orange neon bulb border. Leave the left third of the image solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed sans-serif text in the left black area, right-aligned. Alternate colors between cyan and yellow for each block. Add a main title in a distressed or glowing font inside the top of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the text on the left right-aligned?
Does the border have a visible neon bulb glow effect?
Are the colors strictly cyan, yellow, orange, and black?
Is the car hood at the bottom a solid, bright orange?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the car
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the neon border
Check that palm trees are dark silhouettes
Verify the rounded corners of the main frame
Confirm the color alternation in the tracklist
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a condensed sans-serif sidebar with a framed cinematic illustration featuring a neon-bulb border and a high-contrast warm/cool color split.
